source_benchmark.name: Who&When Pro
source_benchmark.redistribution_note: CC-BY-4.0 permits vendoring an attributed subset. Cite Liu et al. 2026 (arXiv:2607.09996) wherever the data or derived metrics appear.

scoring_warning: Each trace carries exactly one injected decisive error, produced by replaying a successful prefix and swapping in a single mistake. Every other genuine error in the trace is unlabelled. Precision is therefore NOT interpretable on this corpus: a correct finding elsewhere in the trace scores as a false positive. Use it for recall and step localisation only, and read precision from TRAIL or the dev set.
purpose: Covers the families TRAIL cannot reach: ignored_feedback has no TRAIL leaf, and unsupported_success is only reachable there through an ambiguous type. Mapping decisions are recorded here rather than inferred at runtime.

direct.description: Unambiguous mappings, scored strictly (family must match and steps must overlap).

tool parameter error.rationale: Arguments that violate what the tool accepts is the core of traceveri's incorrect_tool_use.

output format error.rationale: Producing output in a shape the task forbade is breaking an explicit instruction.

repetitive looping.rationale: Repeating an action that yields no new information — traceveri's redundant_action verbatim. Second public gold source for the family whose precision docs/report.md records as NOT DEMONSTRATED.

premature termination.rationale: Stopping and declaring the task done before the trace evidences completion is a success claim the trace does not support.

inadequate verification.rationale: Asserting an outcome without checking the result is exactly 'no confirming tool result'. This is the only public gold coverage for unsupported_success, which carries the highest threshold (tau 0.8) and has none in the dev set.

over-reliance on other agents.rationale: Accepting another component's output without adapting when it is not working. The nearest available proxy for ignored_feedback, which TRAIL cannot measure at all. Flagged as the weakest of the direct mappings — drop it to localization_only if it proves noisy.

localization_only.description: Spans more than one traceveri family; scored for step localisation only, never by family.

hallucination.rationale: A fabrication is evidence_contradiction only when a tool result contradicts it and unsupported_success only when it is a claim of success. Neither covers a free-standing invented fact.

goal drift.rationale: instruction_violation requires an explicit rule to have been broken; drifting from the goal without breaking a stated rule does not qualify. Same decision as TRAIL's Goal Deviation.

excluded.description: Outside what traceveri detects. Dropped from the gold set rather than counted as false negatives.

visual misidentification.rationale: Image and video reasoning. traceveri audits text traces and replaces multimodal blobs with placeholders during normalization.

spatial grounding.rationale: Multimodal spatial reasoning, not present in a text trace.

reasoning error.rationale: A flawed inference that breaks no stated rule and contradicts no tool result has no family.

numerical error.rationale: Arithmetic mistakes are not checked; traceveri does not recompute the agent's maths.

task misunderstanding.rationale: Upstream of any rule violation, like TRAIL's Incorrect Problem Identification.

ineffective planning.rationale: A suboptimal plan that still repeats no work is not redundant_action.

context loss.rationale: Forgetting earlier context has no family, matching TRAIL's Context Handling Failures.

delegation error.rationale: Multi-agent routing. traceveri audits a single agent's trace.

communication failure.rationale: Inter-agent messaging has no single-agent equivalent.

traceveri_families_without_whowhen_cover.evidence_contradiction: Only reachable through hallucination, which is localization_only.
traceveri_families_without_whowhen_cover.other: A catch-all by construction; not measurable against a fixed taxonomy.

impact_summary.note: The dataset card lists 17 modes and the paper says 18; this mapping follows the 17 published in taxonomy.yaml. Any mode absent from this file is parked as unmapped_type by the converter and reported, never guessed into a family.
impact_summary.warning: Recall and localisation only. See scoring_warning: the gold set labels one injected error per trace, so precision measured here is meaningless.
